services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Lavish Victorian era furnishings and decor, exquisite stained glass, and detailed woodwork carved by artisans of days gone by… these all combine to create a warm and welcoming experience. Craigdarroch Castle was built for entertaining. Hire a small ensemble of musicians to suit your tastes - the Steinway pianos in both the Drawing Room and the Dance Hall are available for use by professional pianists. With the open staircase, the acoustics are wonderful and music can be heard all through the Castle. If you need some suggestions, we have an extensive list of entertainers from which to choose. blurb: Built by coal baron Robert Dunsmuir during the reign of Queen Victoria and now a National Historic Site, Craigdarroch Castle has been meticulously restored, giving visitors a glimpse of privileged life in the 1890s.
